title: Weak threshold logarithmic ratio
statement: Let $f$ be a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube and let $p$ be real. The weak threshold logarithmic ratio is the natural logarithm of the biased-minus probability polynomial of $f$ at $p$, minus one half the natural logarithm of $p$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
caveat: The supplied statement does not include the definition of the biased-minus probability polynomial.
